newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end sharply lower as franc weakens.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end sharply lower as franc weakens.

text.p: 1620 GMT - Swiss bonds ended sharply lower but above week low with short end also seeing major drop. Prices slipped as the Swiss franc weakened to 21-month lows vs dollar, mark. * Dec Confederate bond futures closed down 54 at 114.31. * 4-1/2 pct Apr 2006 Confederate bond yld 3.942 pct vs 3.888
